hypothesis.primary: The R43 learned reader is not decision-critical because the fusion routes through native features and one seed remains at chance-level heldout FIT accuracy; a contrast-centered, content-only B gate with no native-only bypass can learn to identify the intervening B signal under fresh sources and increase two-seed factual-to-OOD transfer.
hypothesis.null: Improvements disappear when matched learned conventional controls, compute budget, B erasure, position permutation and constant/untrained salience controls are included; no Native-specific mechanism evidenced.
hypothesis.mechanism_diagnostic: Quantify per-step attention, reader, Native backbone and fusion gradient norms, gate saturation and sensitivity to selected B perturbation on the untouched training stream before interpreting a fitted policy as a learned causal selector.

fit.physics: unchanged R43 quartic actual selected-return effects

source.B_effect: selected B measurements only, one signed salience marker 0.24*hidden_gate, noise identical to preregistered R43 functional form but independent salts
source.fifth: selected fifth probe and early history physically generated using original R43 formulas with no hidden-label/model leaks
source.return_goal: minimize (observed post-action final state - 1.0)^2; _record encodes following-before; never add starting state to already decoded physical following state
source.factual_data_policy: Generate alternative action effects in separate actually selected matched worlds; never reveal unseen alternate effect or evaluator-only gate/q, source marker, panel ID to model.
source.freshness: Unique R44 groups and salts, no replay of R42/R43 FIT, DEV, OOD, or original F7 spent first-use
source.split: FIT/CAL/OOD disjoint; no CAL/OOD fitting; repeated re-evaluation after score forbidden

methods.binder: Only original qualified R38 factual-pretrained binder per seed; exact replay fingerprints verified; frozen weights and full replay cost reported

arms.name: r43_additive_native_salience
arms.description: Identical R43 trainable architecture from scratch on fresh R44 FIT

arms.name: multiplicative_native_content_gate
arms.description: Learned content-only B contrast gate explicitly multiplies independently trained native candidate contrast; no native-only action bias

arms.name: multiplicative_history_only_content_gate
arms.description: Same learned B gate and contrast without Native; equal observable information

arms.name: gru_conventional
arms.description: Fully trained GRU factual-pair control with same FIT and budget

arms.name: ssm_conventional
arms.description: Fully trained SSM factual-pair control with same FIT and budget

methods.gate_design: Trainable per-step content score and value projection of 16-d selected B action/effect (32-d input), softmax pooling independent of absolute position, centered learned gate sign; pair-wise factual return CE; compute native influence without enabling native-only override of B causal gate
methods.match_conditions: All neural arms share original FIT pairs, draws, factual information, 256 AdamW updates, 16 paired worlds/update, two starting original seeds, heldout FIT checkpoint without selection; report actual parameter-count, forward FLOPs, CPU/GPU wall-clock, model+controls/full-process compute. If unmatched, strict superiority remains UNVERIFIED.
controls: erase actual selected B marker without privileged marker lookup by using observable extremum
swap observed B between matched opposite-gate worlds
shuffle selected B observations, order only
replace learned selector with constant uniform pooling
methods.reference: FIT-only observable-peak deterministic diagnostic; report as programmatic control, never as trained neural mechanism

frozen_score.primary: Both seeds meet every acceptance term on OOD, with qualification on an untouched CAL and cross-OS exact action parity
frozen_score.strong_science_requires: Matched total compute/capacity and independently owned sealed original source qualification; source-neutral synthetic cannot be SCIENTIFIC_PASS
frozen_score.if_nofit: When either seed fails heldout FIT >=.95, classify optimization failure before interpreting transfer
frozen_score.if_no_salience_necessity: If uniform/zero salience ablations fail to hurt decisions, label Native-only bypass/correlate; no learned-selector gain
frozen_score.if_no_native_gain: If conventional wins or Native ablation fails, credit learned gating if it works but not Native-specific improvement
frozen_score.stopping: No seed substitution, threshold or loss retuning or reuse of consumed CAL/OOD; retain full failures, negatives and near misses

engineering.qualification: Exact-source full G4 Windows+Ubuntu; G5 original TTT Windows+Ubuntu; G7 pinned Mamba-2 Ubuntu; negative controls and cold restore; cross-OS original artifacts and action parity are required after last code change
